items.title: Buster Williams interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 6, 2002
items.q: I’m going out with a singer named Melissa Walker.

ctx.x: Yeah. People can put the lyric in your head as you’re hearing it.
People like to sing these songs that they like. I’m doing a project for this summer, I’m going out with a singer named Melissa Walker. You know Melissa Walker?
